unnamed.title: Unnamed conditions
unnamed.text: A sound strategy fails when internal reality does not match stated intent. Until the hidden misalignment is dealt with, no amount of planning produces the result. Address what is blocking forward movement before improving the plan.

specific.title: Uncomfortably specific
specific.text: A senior team often resists strategic clarity because the direction is uncomfortably specific. The reluctance is personal more than analytical. Ask: which piece of strategic direction is your function hiding from?

competition.title: Competition
competition.text: The most effective competitive strategies target the specific assumptions on which a competitor’s position rests. Identify the foundational assumption, and the position built on it becomes unstable.

value.title: Value Proposition · coherence
value.text: Strategy is proven by the quality and consistency of the environment it produces. Organisations weaken their credibility when branding, claims or public positioning exceed the quality of the lived experience.

arena.title: Arena · who we serve
arena.text: Every organisation exists to do something specific for someone specific. When it loses its sense of who it serves and what it provides, it loses the culture built around that service. Keep the specific customer and mission visible.

known.title: Known, assumed, unseen
known.text: Strategic certainty should be proportional to the available evidence. Leaders must act, and they should distinguish clearly between what is known, what is assumed and what remains outside current visibility.

cost.title: Today’s fix, tomorrow’s cost
cost.text: A decision can solve today’s problem while creating future instability. Assess each objective by the capability, dependency, risk and future consequence it creates.

behind.title: The question behind the question
behind.text: Senior teams often act on the first piece of internal data about an opportunity and miss the second-order question. On every major opportunity, ask the question behind the question before committing.

avoided.title: Named and avoided
avoided.text: The instinct to manage the appearance of a known exposure, and leave the exposure itself unaddressed, turns a survivable warning into a failure. A risk that has been named and then avoided chooses its own moment. Treat a clear warning as a directive to act.
